evidenceSource: Sanitized fields from Apify Actor/build/run/dataset API records; log scans were performed in memory and raw logs were discarded.

run.operatorReportedLikelyAbortCause: The initial response check looked for the user-set cap flag at the run root instead of under options. The run was aborted before cohort results were produced.
run.abortCauseProvenance: Operator-reported; the exact launch/abort gate was not separately retained, so this cause is likely but not independently proven.

interpretation: No cohort result was measured. Zero network bytes and empty logs/dataset indicate no recorded network transfer or output; they do not establish whether any request was attempted before abort.
